gap: BHD is UNCHANGED, so scope does not decide this; ours loses on design. Scope, measured two ways. (a) Against baseline-*.png with the BHD key forced: invoice 972,804/5,184,000 px (18.77%), customer 333,094 (6.43%), dashboard 1440x900 2,074,902 (40.03%), dashboard 390x844 547,694/1,316,640 (41.60%) — all DATA: the seed DB was replaced (company 'Meridian Supply Group'->'COMPANY Name', user Sam->Wave, .example/UAE/Canada clients -> .om/Oman clients, the 'invoice-list-empty' baseline now returns 10 rows, new KPI figures plus a price-calculator banner). In the diff overlay every chrome element renders unchanged: the 220px labelled sidebar and its section headers, the teal Add New Client button, the card frames, the UPPERCASE sort-caret headers, the outlined Company pills. (b) Isolation, data held constant, same session, product forced bhd-erp, accent verified #009bc1 both ways, the wave-empty rule confirmed live then dead: /customer 0 of 5,184,000, /invoice 0 of 5,184,000, dashboard 390x844 0 of 1,316,640; dashboard 1440x900 5,073 px (0.0979%) bbox (1510,1627)-(1811,1799), and two consecutive wave-ON runs reproduce the SAME 5,073 px at the SAME bbox, so it is an animation frame. Real progress on the piece: content ground #f5f9ff, header band #f1f4f9 at 13px with no uppercase, 76px icon-only rail with a pale-blue active pill, one soft-bordered white container with no drop shadow, and the copy is finally truthful and actionable — 'No matches' / 'No invoices match “zzqqxx-no-such-record”. Try a different word, or clear the search.' with a real outlined Clear search pill. r2's lie, r3's desktop void and r4's clipping are fixed; on 390x844 the block now sits y=319-550, above the 788px tab bar and inside the fold. It still does not clearly win. (1) THREE typefaces rasterise on one screen, confirmed by CDP CSS.getPlatformFontsForNode not by declaration: 'Invoice List' = Plus Jakarta Sans, the empty headline + body + Clear search = Inter, the toolbar's 'Add New Invoice' = IBM Plex Sans Arabic Medium. Two pill buttons of identical 40px height and 999px radius sit 349px apart in different faces. Wave's screen is one face throughout, and a typeface mismatch is precisely what kills an expensive read. (2) The screen carries TWO controls called search — a 280x40 filled input holding the query at x=133 and a 220x36 select whose placeholder is literally 'search' at x=461 — while the empty state instructs 'clear the search'. A recovery surface that is ambiguous about which control to recover from is a competence failure. (3) The toolbar mixes two radius languages and three heights: input 40px/8px, select 36px/8px (4px shorter than the buttons it abuts, inset 2px top and bottom), three buttons 40px/999px, plus a bare 32x18 switch with an inline 'Show Deleted' label. Six controls, four treatments; the bar's row is three identical outlined pills and one white field. (4) On mobile the loudest object on a screen that says 'no matches' is a full-width solid #2b57d8 'Add New Invoice' at y~284 — the wrong verb, louder than in r2 — while the correct action sits 230px below it as a quiet outline. (5) Mobile still ships the blank card r3 flagged: the tile ends at y=550, the enclosing card runs to y~704, ~150 CSS px of empty white with a floating lock FAB parked in it; desktop was fixed here and mobile was not. (6) Coverage is still two grammars in one product: /invoice gets the query-aware sentence and the Clear search action, /payment gets tile and mark but keeps AntD's generic 'No Data Found / Records you add will be listed here.' with no action at all, and its header band still carries the sticky-column shadow defect — a grey gradient that ramps then steps abruptly at a seam right of 'Payment Mode' — which /invoice no longer has.
